observedPresentation.controls: Auto, Spin/Stop and bet at right; menu lower left and sound lower right

states.observed: HOLD & SPIN visible; auto and bet enabled; menu/sound visible
SPIN changes to a gold STOP button; auto and bet appear dimmed while request/spin is pending. No STOP action was exercised.
Fresh symbols and multiplier are shown; HOLD & SPIN is restored. Seven completed rounds were losses.
Menu has Rules, Settings and History tabs plus Close; rules scroll through table, gamble/control help, paylines and limits.
Effects and music initially green/on; fullscreen off. Effects was toggled off and restored; settings reopened/closed. Audible output not verified.
Counts 25/50/100/500/1000; 100 selected initially. Three optional thresholds are visible. Start was not pressed.
First visible options 0.10/0.20/0.30/0.40/0.50 DMO. No gameplay bet selection changed.
First session timed out on one click; no completed round counted. Reentry via current official link produced the successful separate session.

documentedOnly.x2: After a win, a red/black guess may double it or lose it; Take Win is documented. No gamble result or transition observed.
documentedOnly.collect: Rules describe collection using Take Win, next spin or automatic collection under autoplay. No winning flow observed.
documentedOnly.disconnection: Accepted bets are described as completing and autoplay switching off. Separate malfunction wording describes voiding/termination. No reconnection/void behavior was tested; do not infer wallet reversals.

futureControlImplementationConstraints.purpose: Future isolated fixture verification of observed pending/loss/modal states. This checkpoint supplies a descriptive state specification only; no control runtime or API behavior is implemented.
futureControlImplementationConstraints.pendingDuplicateSpin: Engineering invariant: emit no second spin intent for a repeated pending action. This is a project integrity requirement, not a claim about untested provider double-tap behavior.
futureControlImplementationConstraints.matchingFixtureReceiptOnly: Consume only a caller-supplied loss observation matching the outstanding local request key and this game; no synthetic wager/receipt is sent to production.
futureControlImplementationConstraints.unsupportedActions: STOP/HOLD/AUTO execution/TURBO/fullscreen/win/collect/X2 are explicitly unsupported until verified, not silently simulated.
